change: Saved arrow joystick preference and double-tap access to the original arrow popup
behavior: Adds Preferences > Keyboard > Use joystick for arrows, enabled by default and saved locally. Enabled: hold/slide retains precision joystick behavior; double-tap toggles the original four-arrow speech-bubble popup. Disabled: single tap toggles the popup, with no joystick steering/overlay. Popup stays open across arrow and outside-key taps, closes by its configured trigger, and resets on target/control/mode changes. Beginning a joystick drag closes the popup and resumes steering. Root accessibility click also toggles popup. Direct arrow taps and holds use the existing repeat/modifier/target pipeline.
phone_install: Installed release 35 on S22+ RFCT21390SD via USB; installed APK checksum matches verified artifact; app data preserved; app not launched
